args.sql: SELECT tickersym, networth, turnoverratio, vol3m, ma200 FROM funds WHERE vol3m IS NOT NULL AND ma200 IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10;

SELECT tickersym, networth, turnoverratio, vol3m, ma200, 
       CASE WHEN vol3m IS NOT NULL AND ma200 IS NOT NULL AND vol3m * ma200 * 252 != 0 
            THEN (networth * turnoverratio) / (vol3m * ma200 * 252)
            ELSE NULL END as plp
FROM funds 
WHERE networth IS NOT NULL AND turnoverratio IS NOT NULL AND vol3m IS NOT NULL AND ma200 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY plp DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    f.tickersym,
    f.shortlabel,
    f.geozone,
    f.productclass,
    ROUND(CAST(f.networth AS numeric), 2) as net_worth,
    ROUND(CAST(f.turnoverratio AS numeric), 4) as turnover_ratio,
    ROUND(CAST(f.vol3m AS numeric), 2) as avg_daily_vol_3m,
    ROUND(CAST(f.ma200 AS numeric), 4) as price_ma200,
    ROUND(CAST((f.networth * f.turnoverratio) / (f.vol3m * f.ma200 * 252) AS numeric), 6) as portfolio_liquidity_pressure
FROM funds f
WHERE f.networth IS NOT NULL 
  AND f.turnoverratio IS NOT NULL 
  AND f.vol3m IS NOT NULL 
  AND f.ma200 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY portfolio_liquidity_pressure DESC
LIMIT 20;

)
